name: dropsort
description: DropSort - Smart Desktop File Organizer for macOS
author: DropSort

extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: DropSort needs access to your Downloads folder to scan and organize the files you choose.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: DropSort needs access to your Desktop folder to scan and organize the files you choose.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: DropSort needs access to your Documents folder to scan and organize the files you choose.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: DropSort needs access to external drives you choose to scan and organize their files.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: DropSort needs access to network folders you choose to scan and organize their files.
